ns2:course.label: Special Flight Ratings
ns2:course.description: Consists of aeronautical experience that can be used for special FAA certificates and/or ratings such as Airline Transport Pilot or Rotercraft-helicopter. Course may also be used for specialized flight such as advanced multi-engine operations. Sixteen hours of discussion and a variable number of hours of flight instruction (dual and/or solo) to meet the individual needs of the student. Students enrolling in this course will also participate in up to five hours of research flight experiments conducted by the Institute of Aviation staff. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Pilot certificate and consent of director.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Pilot certificate and consent of director.
